integrity: Full proof plus an independent finite brute-force cross-check is supplied; exhaustive parameter checks are finite corroboration, not substitutes for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for non-cyclic binary words of weight two, ordered contiguous k-mer multisets, k>=2 and n>=3k-2; no claims for shorter words, other weights, cyclic/noisy/incomplete observations, or independent validation. A possible implicit equivalence with broad Markov-type results is unresolved, though inspected stated results do not cover this exact law.
title: Sharp stabilization and complete ambiguity of binary weight-two linear k-mer multispectra
